verdict.reason: A protected cohort failed its predeclared evidence minimum or nonregression limit.

aggregate_verdict.reason: Promotion refused: the candidate evidence carries 1 sample(s), below the required minimum of 10. A noisy sample below the minimum count is not statistically bounded improvement.

report.remedy: Register a new plan and fresh candidate before collecting a different cohort or making another evaluation look.

limitation: Descriptive constant-policy status-role replay, no inference, training or causal improvement claim. One repository counts as one independent unit; the aggregate also refuses insufficient samples.
